subject.title: feat(firecrawl): add keyless Firecrawl Search (Free) provider + richer firecrawl_search options

question: Should OpenClaw accept `firecrawl-free` as an official opt-in keyless hosted Firecrawl search provider, given that it sends user search queries to Firecrawl without credentials and Firecrawl's docs still declare bearer auth for Search?
rationale: The code can preserve key isolation, but only maintainers can decide whether this hosted no-auth search/privacy boundary is a supported product surface rather than a contributor-only experiment.

options.title: Accept opt-in provider after rebase
options.body: Approve the `firecrawl-free` provider direction, require conflict resolution, and re-check exact-head live proof before merge.

options.title: Split search option parity only
options.body: Ask for a narrower PR that keeps `firecrawl_search` parameter parity while leaving keyless search out of the official provider list.

options.title: Pause keyless Firecrawl search
options.body: Close or pause the keyless provider until Firecrawl documents or sponsors no-auth search as a stable upstream contract.

recommendation.title: Accept opt-in provider after rebase
recommendation.body: Approve the `firecrawl-free` provider direction, require conflict resolution, and re-check exact-head live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the merged narrow keyless Firecrawl scrape implementation and is the closest recent owner for the adjacent hosted Firecrawl access boundary.
